correctness.rationale: The proximal formula follows by orthogonal mean/contrast separation. The active Jacobian has quotient form aI+(1-a)uu^T and the exact rank-one BV norm reduces to edge signs and central steps. The two-vector spectral identity and extremal alternating signs prove the closed formula for all n. A one-sided boundary perturbation realizes the sharp limit, and the strict active-derivative bound rules out finite equality for n>=3. Standard-library finite checks reproduced all stated identities and sampled inequalities.

value.rationale: This is a natural full classification of a canonical mean-preserving group shrinkage map on path variation: exact n-dependence, sharp nonattaining boundary geometry, a penalty-zero jump, and a linear instability incompatible with its Hilbert nonexpansivity. The result gives a substantive quantitative stability distinction and reproducible sharp examples for arbitrary dimension.
